addClaims.text: The Advertising API (and Community Management, Lead Sync, Conversions, Matched Audiences) is open to all approved developers via the standard application.
addClaims.quote: Matched Audiences API are open to all approved developers — apply through the standard process.

addClaims.text: Audience Insights and Media Planning APIs are restricted to developers who meet additional criteria evaluated by LinkedIn.
addClaims.quote: Access to Audience Insights and Media Planning APIs is restricted to developers who meet additional qualification criteria evaluated by LinkedIn.

addClaims.text: You apply for an API under the Products tab of your app and complete an access form.
addClaims.quote: Apply to the desired API under the Products tab of your app. - Complete the access form.

addClaims.text: Advertising API permissions include r_ads, rw_ads and r_ads_reporting, available once approved for Advertising API access.
addClaims.quote: Available to all developers approved for Advertising API access. Apply to Advertising API.

addClaims.text: Composio does not manage an OAuth app for Linkedin Ads: toolkits.get("linkedin_ads") returns composioManagedAuthSchemes [] (auth modes: OAUTH2), so you bring your own.

addRequirements.label: Advertising API access application (Products tab → access form)
addRequirements.when: Before any Marketing API scope (r_ads, rw_ads, r_ads_reporting) works

addUncertainties: LinkedIn does not publish a review time for Advertising API applications; the production range is an estimate.
